text:
Jake DeBrusk is doing what Vancouver pays him for: getting to the net and shooting. He has 8 goals in 24 games, 5 of them in his last ten, plus the shootout winner against Minnesota on Saturday, a soft flip under the bar that Pass it to Bulis' Daniel Wagner called "so cheeky."

The underlying number we like most is his chance count. His 9.49 expected goals work out to 1.4 per 60 minutes, a first-line rate, and he is actually scoring a touch below it. If anything, the goals have been earned the hard way, often deflections and rebounds around the crease. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 55% of his shots come off the rush, so he's at his most dangerous right after a turnover.

The catch is Vancouver as a whole. The Canucks get outshot badly with him on the ice, though less than when he sits. Our range has him at 21 to 34 goals, and the middle of that would be a very good year on a team that needs one.
